modules.name: minisvc.cli
modules.purpose: Console entry point that loads environment settings, constructs the repository, initializes the schema, and reports readiness.

modules.name: minisvc.config
modules.purpose: Defines immutable Settings and translates MINISVC_DB and MINISVC_READONLY environment values into runtime configuration.

modules.name: minisvc.models
modules.purpose: Defines the Order dataclass used across handlers and SQLite persistence.

modules.name: minisvc.storage.repo
modules.purpose: SQLite-backed repository for creating the orders table, inserting orders, and retrieving orders.

modules.name: minisvc.api.routes
modules.purpose: Binds POST and GET order endpoints to handler functions through an injected app and repository.

modules.name: minisvc.api.handlers
modules.purpose: Converts request payloads to Orders, persists or retrieves them, and builds response dictionaries with in-memory audit event data.

modules.name: minisvc.audit
modules.purpose: Builds order audit event dictionaries; it has no storage or external side effects.

key_functions.description: Loads settings, creates OrderRepository, initializes schema, and returns exit code 0.
Maps environment variables to Settings; defaults database_path to orders.sqlite and readonly to false.
Registers POST /orders and GET /orders/<order_id> callbacks on an injected app.
Indexes required payload keys, converts total_cents to int, saves an Order, and returns a created response plus an event dictionary.
Reads by order ID and returns either a missing response or serialized order data plus a read event.
Creates the SQLite orders table if absent.
Inserts an Order into SQLite using parameterized SQL; duplicate IDs or database failures propagate.
Queries SQLite by order_id and reconstructs an Order when a row exists.
Returns an in-memory event dictionary for an order action; it does not write an audit record.

runtime_flows.name: CLI startup
steps: load_settings selects MINISVC_DB or orders.sqlite and parses MINISVC_READONLY.
main calls repo.init_schema(), creating SQLite table orders if needed.
main prints readiness and returns 0; readonly is not enforced.

runtime_flows.name: HTTP create-order
steps: An app calls register_routes(app, repo), which binds POST /orders.
The POST callback invokes create_order(payload, repo).
create_order reads order_id and customer and converts total_cents with int().
create_order constructs Order and calls repo.save(order).
repo.save inserts into the SQLite orders table and propagates database errors; it does not retry.
create_order builds an in-memory order_event and returns the created response; no audit row is persisted.
